{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe the federal government must commit to providing full funding to fulfill unmet trust and treaty obligations to Tribal Nations and Native American peoples.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work on a nation-to-nation basis to increase funding, resources, and financial tools for Tribes, particularly in the key areas of criminal justice, health care, education, housing, and economic development.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to address the predictability of funding for Tribes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will explore pathways including mandatory funding, advanced appropriations, shutdown exemptions, and other mechanisms to address the predictability of funding for Tribes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The COVID-19 pandemic has devastated Indian Country, with some Tribal communities facing among the highest per capita infection rates in the country.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"As part of a commitment to fighting the COVID-19 pandemic, Democrats will support funding to hire sufficient staff to conduct contact tracing for all who test positive for this deadly disease.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will surge funding to the Indian Health Service as part of a commitment to fighting the COVID-19 pandemic.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support investments to help Tribal governments address the economic fallout of the COVID-19 pandemic and President Trump's recession.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support investments to support and create jobs in Tribal communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support affordable child care so parents are not forced to choose between keeping their jobs and keeping their children safe.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
